# ARM v3: June 30, 2026 re-anchor

Re-anchors the independently reviewed ARM v2 research (March 31, 2026 origin) to the Q1 FY2027 Form 6-K (period ended June 30, 2026; filed July 29, 2026; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1973239/000197323926000114/arm-20260630.htm).

Unchanged from v2: every scenario growth, margin, investment, tax, WACC, terminal and funding assumption.

Changed: capital and discount origin (June 30), cash and short-term investments, EDA obligations, finance leases (conservative bound), minimum operating cash (5% of trailing revenue), ordinary shares (1,068m as filed, rounded) and the FY2027 opening stub (full year less reported Q1).

The re-anchor is mechanical and has not been independently reviewed. Values: bear $8.8331, base $26.1462, bull $63.7177 per ADS.

Rebuild with `node scripts/build-arm-v3-incremental.mjs`.
